message: 酌み取り合戦

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heya, Synn-kun~~」
While I was checking that everything was completely packed up, Sacchin called out to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, hey. The Sweets Club did a cake buffet, right? Did you guys finish cleaning up properly?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Forget about that--Azel-chan didn't show up today either, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「F-Forget about that...? Hmm, I wonder if Azel is sick? Should we go visit her?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're way too nice for your own good, boss~ She's totally skipping class, y'know~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She's a delinquent~, a delinquent~ I wish I had the courage to skip class too~」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not what you call courage.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wish I had the recklessness to skip class too~」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, you just phrased it differently.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan, Azel-chan, report to the chairwoman's office at once. That is an order~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Honyara~!? Oh no, she's being summoned by High Command~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa... She's definitely gonna get scolded about her attendance days. I have to go help Azel!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See ya~, bye-by~e.」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me for not knocking. Helena-san, um--」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Synn-chan\s04 I figured you'd show up soon.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That concludes the explanation of this board game. Did you understand the rules?」

name: Azel
message: 「Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Melilot-san was also in the chairwoman's office, and on the table sat a complex sugoroku-like board and a small roulette wheel.

name: Helena
message: 「Normally, the punishment assignment for an unexcused absence is cleaning this room...」

name: Helena
message: 「Hahaha. But this time, you're gonna play a game with me, alright?」

name: Azel
message: 「I said I accept.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you defeat Helena, any future absences will be treated as excused, even if you take every day off.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh... Whaaat!?」
Aren't those extraordinarily generous terms? ...In short, does that mean Azel has almost zero chance of winning?
Why would Helena-san do something like this?

name: Azel
message: 「What did you come here for?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanted to help you out, Azel. We're classmates, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, why not? Azel-chan needs a reliable strategist, you know~?」

name: Azel
message: 「Just as the Chairwoman has that librarian?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe, that's precisely right.」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then... ta-daaa! Let the battle begin♪」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wait a second, please!」

name: Helena
message: 「No, I shan't wait!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... I'll read through the rulebook right away!」
I pick up the booklet sitting beside the roulette wheel and skim through it.

name: Synn
message: 「I'll help out too, okay, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph, do as you please.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, basically it's a territory-conquering game.」
In practice, it's quite an advanced game. Players split into three factions--Country A, Country B, and Country C--and aim for world domination.
Helena-san vs. Melilot-san vs. Azel and me.
Surprisingly, there is extremely little written explanation.
Instead, it's packed with visually intuitive diagrams, illustrations, and monochrome photographs of real-world scenery that likely served as the inspiration for the setting.
Azel stretches up on tiptoe to peek into the manual I'm holding open. Could it be she doesn't actually understand the rules?

name: Azel
message: 「...Hehe.」
Huh? Is she looking at the photos?

name: Azel
message: 「Every single photograph is so peaceful. How delightful...」

name: Azel
message: 「What colors are these countries in reality? Do you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, I cannot tell. There are two types of black-and-white photographic film: one where yellow develops as black, and one where it develops as white.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, so you don't know...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel, the game has already begun. Please concentrate.」
Melilot spins the roulette and advances her piece by the number rolled.

name: Melilot
message: 「Rather than gazing at the scenes in the manual, please look at the board. And not only that, look at this world as well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As long as you keep your eyes open, the sights will come pouring right in.」

name: Azel
message: 「They are open. All sorts of things are coming into view. Everything I never paid attention to before.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's wonderful. It must be trying to teach you something, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's certainly suggesting something. But I can't quite grasp what it is.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if you do not understand, you need only not forget. As long as you do not forget, you will surely become it.」

name: Synn
message: 「...? Become what?」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, we don't know either, so don't ask!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right.」
What a weird conversation, I can't focus...

name: Synn
message: 「In this game, do you win by capturing the opposing country's king?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. As long as something exists to take the place of the king or the royal capital, the battle will never end.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Realistic, isn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If there is no end, the world will endure, and though it will be in the far, distant future, humanity will eventually surpass the angels.」
Didn't that suddenly stop being realistic...?

name: Azel
message: 「Humans do nothing but fight.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, what a gloomy way to put it. You're making the Chairwoman sad, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「I won't deny what you said, Azel, but the driving force that has changed the human world is a wonderfully energetic optimism that says, 'where there's a will, there's a way.'」

name: Azel
message: 「Foolish.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so? Why not try turning your spirit of denial into a spirit of affirmation and look at things that way?」

name: Azel
message: 「That is nothing more than sentimentality. Do not mistake such a thing for dogma.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee, rather than spitting at the heavens, I would much rather dream.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not interested.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Ummm...」
I'm in trouble. I don't get it.
A conversation is somehow happening between Azel, Helena-san, and Melilot-san, yet I can't keep up at all.

name: Helena
message: 「Then be intoxicated, child of heaven. For now, simply be intoxicated, until your desires seep through you to your heart's content.」

name: Azel
message: 「Nonsense. I don't see the necessity in doing so without weighing right and wrong.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That being said, allowing whimsical illusions to force sacrifices upon others also goes against reason, wouldn't you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hrmm, hrmm, hrmm.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!? Oh... Could it be that Melilot-san is the type of person who throws her opponent off with a shamisen during a match?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe, that would be Helena.」

name: Helena
message: 「How mean! If anything, rather than a shamisen, I'm the type who prefers plucking at girls' boobs~」

name: Melilot
message: 「Wha...! Y-You wouldn't--」

name: Helena
message: 「And a-one, and a-two~♪ Squeeze, squeeze, squeeze, squeeze, squeeze, squeeze!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Where do you think you're touching?! Please stop!」

name: Melilot
message: 「A-Ahn... ngh, doing something like this right in front of a student...!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't know where to look...」

name: Azel
message: 「...Pointless.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, meaning is something you find with your own strength.」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan, you've been sneaking around in the middle of the night, haven't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You were a delinquent!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even on academy grounds, a night road is the road to the underworld, you know? If you aren't careful, you'll end up in a situation just like this~♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「U-Uuu~... ngh, can you not give advice in a more decent manner?!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Helena
message: 「Very well! Now, let's continue our match.」
...Despite my support, Azel suffered a crushing defeat. Helena-san isn't the type of person to throw a match on purpose.
Considering she's an exchange student from a country with different customs, her past absences will be wiped clean--provided she attends school properly starting tomorrow.
As a chairwoman who looks out for her students, it was a ruling brimming with leniency.
And I'm the witness... Starting tomorrow, I've really got to keep a closer eye on Azel!
